answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 21994 Country: India Title: i want to ask a question is jamat salat of two persons allowed? Question: Assalamo aliakum mufti sahab i want to ask a question is jamat salat of two persons allowed? Answer ID: 21994 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 682/517/D=1431) Yes it is allowed. The muqtadi will stand right side of the Imam a little back, the muqtadi shall place his feet fingers in line with imam?s heels. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
